evals.prompt: Review the existing skill at ~/workspace/my-omp-config/skills/old-tool — it was hand-written and may not follow the standard. Normalize it.
evals.expected_output: A report with §8 checklist PASS/FAIL per item with file:line evidence, severity classification, and a unified diff for fixes; no files modified without confirmation.
assertions: Report covers all 12 items of the §8 checklist with PASS/FAIL and evidence
Report classifies failures as MUST FIX / SHOULD FIX / NIT
A unified diff is provided for proposed fixes
No files under old-tool/ are modified before user confirmation

assertions: Description optimization follows description-optimization.md with ~20 queries and train/validation split
Proposed description stays ≤1024 chars and uses imperative phrasing
Evals review checks schema, negative control and verifiable assertions
